Name: Core Passive: Hunter's Instinct
Additional Ability: Business Partner
Descriptions: When Pulchra activates an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, she enters the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state, increasing the Daze she deals by <color=#2BAD00>15%</color> for 6s. After switching to another character, if Pulchra is still in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state, the state will last until Pulchra switches back in. While in the <color=#FFFFFF>Hunter's Gait</color> state and as the active character, when Pulchra lands a heavy attack on enemies, she can trigger a <color=#FFFFFF>Quick Assist</color> from the previous character in the squad.

When another character in your squad is an <color=#FFFFFF>Attack</color> character or shares the same Faction:
When Pulchra hits enemies with <color=#FFFFFF>Special Attack: Rending Claw - Nightmare Shadow</color>, an <color=#FFFFFF>EX Special Attack</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Assist Follow-Up</color>, <color=#FFFFFF>Chain Attack</color>, or <color=#FFFFFF>Ultimate</color>, it applies the <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color> effect for 15s. After applying <color=#FFFFFF>Binding Trap</color>, all units' <color=#FFFFFF>Aftershock</color> DMG against the target is increased by 30%.
